author: simulation_agent

inequalities.inequality: the periodic box is commensurate with a triangular lattice

precondition.requires: Choose n_particles = 2*m*n and a box with Ly/Lx = n*sqrt(3)/(2*m) at the target density, so that a defect-free triangular lattice fits the periodic cell. Otherwise the psi6 plateau is capped by frustration and the relaxation time measures the box, not the suspension.

inequalities.inequality: the potential cutoff is inside half the box and outside the potential's reach

precondition.requires: Set the pair cutoff so that u(r_cut)/kT is below one thousandth at the largest Gamma and longest range of the sweep, and below half the box edge; declare it in the plan.

note: Two of the four inequalities are preconditions rather than intervals because they restrict a shape and not a value; S4 must carry them, not intersect them.

numbers.name: bead_diameter
numbers.note: the lab's particles, measured by the operator on 2026-09-19 (CV at most 2 per cent). Taken from the store under the S2 id as the physical-units anchor; see the constraint note on anchoring

numbers.name: diffusivity
numbers.note: the free diffusivity D0 of one particle in the bath; the Brownian time at the mean spacing, a^2/D0, is the natural time unit of the relaxation and every axis derives it from this

numbers.name: spacing_over_diameter
numbers.note: mean centre-to-centre spacing in diameters; sets the area fraction, about 0.2 for a triangular arrangement at 2

numbers.name: mean_spacing
numbers.note: a = rho**-1/2 at the reference density; the density sweep moves it by less than a decade

numbers.name: brownian_time
numbers.note: the time to diffuse one spacing: the natural unit of structural relaxation here, and NOT tau_d, which is the time to diffuse one diameter and belongs to the free-tracer question

assumptions.statement: Two diameters of spacing is a reference density where a 2D Yukawa suspension is neither dilute nor jammed, so the sweep in strength and range has room on both sides. Nothing physical picks it; the density is one of the swept parameters and this is the point about which it is swept.
assumptions.falsifier: a person naming the area fraction of interest, or a first run showing the plateau unreachable at this density inside budget, moves the reference

assumptions.statement: The psi6 correlation length grows toward the box as the structure orders, so finite size is never absent here and the box can only be made large against the spacing. Thirty spacings keeps the ordering time from being set by the box for the part of the sweep that orders, and is a margin rather than a measured threshold.
assumptions.falsifier: two box sizes a factor of two apart giving the same relaxation time within its error retire the margin at that sweep point

kb_refs.claim: The particles in the bottle in use have a diameter of 5 micrometres, with a coefficient of variation no greater than 2 per cent, measured directly by the operator on 2026-09-19.
